text:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a quiet-window deploy today 17:30 PT (stable v3.8). Who's owning the canary, smoke, and the off-ramp? Need rollback criteria + smoke checklist by T-20. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-undo
mel: I can own the canary and initial metrics. @dan for infra watch, @jenny for app smoke. I'll post go/no-go at T-15. :thumbsup:
priya: Added a short rollback checklist to the runbook section (see 'minimal undo'). TL;DR: toggle traffic -> verify no data corruption -> revert DB migration if needed.
dan: Infra locked down for the window (autoscaler frozen, no infra deploys). Off-ramp trigger we agreed: latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 1% sustained for 5m. I'll execute routing change if triggered.
jenny: Smoke checklist (short):
1) health endpoint ok
2) representative sample generation passes
3) embeddings pipeline consumer lag < 2x
Commands:```curl -fsS https://api.prod.redwood/health || echo "HEALTH_FAIL"
python tools/smoke_sample.py --model stable-v3.8 --timeout 5``` 
I have the smoke script in ops/tools/smoke.sh
taylor: DB migration is a pre-step (non-blocking if revert possible). Staging migration passed; rollback plan is snapshot restore + toggle off model traffic. Steps in runbook under "migration undo".
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created for 17:30 PT (start_ts=2490011400). Linked: https://deploys.redwood/internal/2490011222
alex: Good. At T-15 (17:15 PT) I need explicit acks from: canary-owner, app-smoke-owner, infra-owner. If anyone can't make that, call it out now.
mel: ACK — I'll be on standby and will publish canary dashboard at T+5 after canary launch.
jenny: ACK — smoke script ready, will run at T+2 (canary).
priya: ACK — rollback criteria doc is up, automated off-ramp will flip 20% traffic back to previous variant, manual full rollback if data issues.
dan: ACK — infra oncall standing by, will enact network reroute if off-ramp triggers.
oncall-sre: On standby, will monitor SLOs during window. Ping @oncall-sre in ops channel to escalate.
alex: Perfect. Final go/no-go at 17:15 PT. If silence, proceed as planned but prefer an explicit ok. Thanks everyone.
